text:
alex: Quick thread to plan a 4-email hands-on lab series after launch. Goal: get people to run a 3-step lab, see a tiny benchmark, then invite to a live deep-dive. Keep copy punchy and code-first for devs.

tori: love the idea. propose segments: lab_rsvps (signed up for lab), active_trials (started a trial), enterprise_ops (company email + >50 emp).

mike: mapping exists but needs enrich: add columns for intent_score and last_doc_view. i'll export tomorrow.

alex: cadence: L1 welcome + lab quickstart (day 0), L2 benchmark card + 2-line how-to (day 2), L3 cheat-sheet + 1-min curl (day 6), L4 invite to live bench workshop (day 12).

jana: subject ideas L1: "Try the Redwood lab: 3 steps, 5 minutes" vs "Hands-on: run a quick Redwood lab". test on lab_rsvps only.

tori: creative: L2 include a small PNG showing latency vs baseline (annotated), keep <100KB. L3 include a tiny code screenshot or inline curl.

mike: curl snippet for L3 (keep single-line): ```bash
curl -sS -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -H "Authorization: Bearer $KEY" -d '{"prompt":"hello"}'
``` put this only in lab_rsvps and active_trials.

alex: tracking: opens, click, lab_started (custom event), workshop_reg, trial_start. UTMs: utm_campaign=lab_series_q3 and utm_content={segment}. create cohort lab_series_q3_lab_rsvps.

jana: send windows: lab_rsvps Tue 9am PT, active_trials Thu 10am PT, enterprise_ops Mon 11am PT. For enterprise show enterprise calendar link `https://cal.redwood.ai/enterprise?utm_medium=email`.

tori: rollout plan: stage A = lab_rsvps (~3k). send L1 -> monitor opens 24h -> if open <13% swap subject and retry to non-openers. if lab_started >=4% proceed to full send.

mike: CSV export ETA tomorrow 9:30am to #marketing-assets. Columns: email,segment,intent_score,last_doc_view,company,company_size,signup_ts,exclude_flag.

alex: owners: mike = segment export + suppressions, jana = subject + creative QA, tori = send ops (Braze), me = copy + final. marketing-bot set reminder: drafts due Fri EOD.

jana: suppression rules: exclude unsubscribed in last 90d, bounced in last 180d, internal domains, and anyone who already attended a similar workshop. also exclude trialers who already completed the lab.

tori: measurement: funnel = email -> lab_started -> workshop_reg -> trial_start. monitor at 7 and 14 days. tag mail_variant for subject tests.

mike: creative constraints: one image per email, total size <120KB, always include alt text and plain-text fallback. GIFs allowed only if <80KB.

alex: copy constraints: keep L1 body <110 words, others <130 words, single primary CTA. for high-intent (intent_score>85) swap workshop CTA with 1-click demo booking link `https://cal.redwood.ai/demo?utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=lab_series_q3`.

jana: small legal note: any quantified claim in L2 needs a footnote with test parameters. we'll add a single-line footnote.

marketing-bot: reminder set: campaign draft due Fri EOD and dry-run to internal list next Mon. :spiral_calendar_pad:

tori: ok team — i'll build the Braze template with a Liquid block to swap CTA by segment. will post test send results here after Stage A.

alex: thanks all. quick follow-up: include a 1-sentence developer testimonial in L2 to boost trust. we'll reconvene here after copy drop. :rocket:
